controls.purpose: Record relation, intent, requested authority requirements, hazards, and trace without granting action authority.
Ground current-state claims with bounded reads.
Protect one mechanical local edit with a targeted check.
Plan, implement, review, and regress a bounded behavior change.
Track dependent obligations and partial repair.
Persist program worklines, checkpoints, and joins.
Select a bounded dynamic-actor simulation contract by default and escalate only explicit controlled campaigns to campaign governance.
Protect trust, permission, secret, tenant, and hard-action boundaries with fail-closed host verification.
Inventory an otherwise unbounded public or security contract.
Require current-source, independent, environment-bound release evidence.
